title: What are Gems?

body.text: custom AI assistants you create for a specific purpose
, similar to OpenAI's Custom GPTs. You can set a role, give knowledge, and define the response style for each Gem.

example: "I want to create a Gem that's a 'fitness coach' to recommend personal workout programs."

title: How are Gems different from a normal chat?

body.text: A normal chat with Gemini starts fresh every time, but a Gem
remembers the role and instructions you set across every conversation
, so you don't have to re-explain the context each time you use it.

example: "[Open the 'Professional Translator' Gem] Translate this into formal Japanese: Thank you for trusting us."
